summary.zh-Hans: 恩托托公园位于亚的斯亚贝巴的山地，周围有桉树林，是城中可进行户外休闲的空间。
summary.en: Entoto Park occupies mountain terrain in Addis Ababa, surrounded by eucalyptus woodland, with spaces for outdoor recreation.

names.zh-Hans: 埃塞俄比亚科学博物馆

summary.zh-Hans: 亚的斯亚贝巴科学博物馆的建筑外形包含圆环与圆顶。馆内设有常设展与临时展览。
summary.en: The Science Museum in Addis Ababa has ring-shaped and domed buildings, with permanent and temporary exhibitions.

summary.zh-Hans: 英吉拉是埃塞俄比亚的发酵薄饼，可用苔麸粉制作。制作中的发酵和烘烤会影响成品。
summary.en: Injera is an Ethiopian fermented flatbread that can be made with teff flour. Fermentation and baking affect the finished bread.

summary.zh-Hans: 希罗可用鹰嘴豆或豌豆磨成的粉与香料制作，配英吉拉薄饼食用。豆粉种类并非只有一种。
summary.en: Shiro can be prepared with flour made from chickpeas or peas and mixed with spices. It is served with injera, and more than one kind of pulse flour is used.
